Q5651.reason: The 'as is' clause disclaims implied warranties of condition but not the express description of the car as a 1964 model, which formed part of the basis of the bargain.

Q5672.reason: If the shooter's acquittal rested on self-defense, the killing was justified and so not an unlawful homicide, whereas insanity and diminished capacity are personal excuses that don't help the instigator.

Q8537.reason: Separating the concept from its justification keeps the definition of punishment value-neutral so justification can be argued separately.
